Visual design completed. Here's a summary of the visual strategy applied:

## Visual Design Summary

| Slide | Strategy | Key Visual Element |
|-------|----------|-------------------|
| 1 | Full-bleed image | Dramatic opening with "Will You Lead or Follow?" |
| 2 | **Single number** | "$7.5B" - Jobs-style impact |
| 3 | Mermaid diagram | Google + Apple converging (4 nodes) |
| 4 | **Single number** | "2026" in red - deadline urgency |
| 5 | **Single number** | "110,000" - talent gap crisis |
| 6 | Mermaid diagram | Binary choice: hire fails → train (3 nodes) |
| 7 | Two-cols + v-clicks | Program intro with logos |
| 8 | Full-bleed image | Vitalik credibility photo |
| 9 | Styled cards + v-clicks | Achievement proof points |
| 10 | Mermaid diagram | Theme → Solutions → Hiring (4 nodes) |
| 11 | Mermaid diagram | 1 investment → 3 ROIs (4 nodes) |
| 12 | Tier cards + v-clicks | Pricing tiers (¥500K/¥1M/¥2M) |
| 13 | Full-bleed + QR | Clear CTA with QR code |

## Quality Results

- **Bullet points used**: 0 (all converted to visuals)
- **Max Mermaid nodes**: 4 (under 5-node limit)
- **Image placeholders**: 10 (covers all credibility/anecdote/CTA slides)
- **Color palette**: 100% consistent with defined scheme

The design follows the Jobs-BCG mindset: every slide passes the 3-second test, and the visual hierarchy prioritizes single numbers and diagrams over text.
